d:
Chinese vloggers have reportedly been livestreaming from poor neighbourhoods in Dhaka.
Some allegedly presented the footage as scenes from New Delhi, India.
The videos reportedly included derogatory comments about Indian living conditions.
Earlier reports suggest Chinese vloggers have been filming in these areas for months.
However, there is no confirmation yet that the activity is part of an organised disinformation campaign.
